# Klinica

> Klinica is a SaaS platform that gives clinics and medical practices a branded online presence with appointment booking, patient management, and smart scheduling — no technical setup required.

Klinica is designed for independent clinics, private doctors, and small medical practices that want to move their operations online. Each clinic gets its own subdomain (e.g., dr-smith.klinica.space) with a public-facing landing page, an online booking form, and a private admin panel. The platform handles the full patient lifecycle: booking requests, patient records, employee accounts, appointment history, and automated email reminders.

Klinica is currently in open beta with 200+ clinics onboarded. It is built on Laravel and deployed in Europe.

## Platform Pages

- [Home](https://klinica.space/): Platform overview, features, pricing, and trial signup
- [Register](https://klinica.space/register): Create a new clinic account and choose a subdomain
- [Pricing](https://klinica.space/#pricing): Plan comparison — Starter and Pro tiers
- [Privacy Policy](https://klinica.space/privacy): Data handling and GDPR compliance
- [Terms of Service](https://klinica.space/terms): Usage terms and conditions
- [DPA](https://klinica.space/dpa): Data Processing Agreement for GDPR Article 28
- [Refund Policy](https://klinica.space/refund-policy): Subscription refund terms

## Plans

- **Free Trial**: Full access for a limited period, no credit card required
- **Starter** (entry tier): Up to 20 patients, 1 employee account, 30 bookings/month, AES-256 encryption, audit logs
- **Pro** (€49/month): Unlimited patients, unlimited employees, unlimited bookings, 10 GB storage, automated email reminders, priority support

## Key Features

- Public clinic landing page with services list and online booking form
- Patient records with appointment history and contact information
- Employee (staff) account management
- Automated email reminders to reduce no-shows
- AES-256 encryption at rest for patient data
- Audit logs for compliance
- GDPR data export for patients and bookings
- Paddle-powered subscription billing

## Technology

Built with Laravel, Filament (admin panel), Livewire, and Tailwind CSS. Multi-tenant architecture: each clinic runs in an isolated database. Hosted on Hetzner Cloud in Europe.

## Target Audience

Independent clinics, private doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, dermatologists, and any small medical practice in need of an online booking system and patient management tool.
